messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert: high 5xx error rate detected on inference-gateway-prod (error_rate > 8% over 3m) — page sent to #incidents and P0 on-call
Maya Chen: seeing spikes in p95 latency and a flurry of 503s. UI dashboards look like a cascade starting at the auth-proxy.
Priya Singh: can everyone drop what they're doing and join the call? Jumping into the runbook: /runbooks/inference-gateway-outage
Liam O'Connor: joining. grabbing logs now. tailing ingress logs: ```
2026-06-03T12:01:02Z inference-gateway auth: token validation failed: user_id=null
2026-06-03T12:01:03Z proxy: upstream connection reset by peer
2026-06-03T12:02:10Z router: 503 generated for /v1/generate
```
Maya Chen: initial mitigation: flipping traffic to fallback-region (eu-west-1) for read-only inference routes, canarying writes off. Doing a weighted 20% -> 80% shift now.
Ravi Patel: started rolling restart of auth-proxy deployment with zero-downtime flags. Patching a regression from yesterday's config change to token cache (reverting cache-ttl=1s -> 60s).
Support-Bot: Customer Impact: 37 active customers affected (partial failures), highest impact on accounts with session-affinity. Opened customer tickets: TKT-4212, TKT-4213.
Priya Singh: logging shows token fetches to KMS timed out under load; correlation: KMS client retries bubbled up and exhausted causing auth-proxy threads to block. Suggest rate-limit KMS calls and enable local cache.
Liam O'Connor: root cause hypothesis noted. For now we've increased local cache and re-enabled flow. Restart completed on auth-proxy. Observability: error rate down to 2.1% and p95 latency improving.
oncall-rotation-bot: @Maya Chen handing off to @Liam O'Connor for next 30m (on-call handoff).
Maya Chen: handing off ongoing mitigation and customer comms to Liam. I'll stay in thread for postmortem. :thumbsup:
Liam O'Connor: taking over. I'll own post-incident tasks and timeline capture. Please add any logs or artifacts to the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/1719901123/
Priya Singh: noted one more thing — audit logs from 12:03 to 12:17 appear incomplete in the central audit-store. We have partial ingestion failures. This is likely due to the same auth-proxy stalls.
Security Team: flagged — missing audit entries are a compliance concern. Need to preserve evidence and capture a forensics snapshot of affected hosts.
Ravi Patel: snapshot initiated for impacted auth-proxy pods and node-level logs saved to /var/logs/incident-1719901123.tar.gz; uploading to evidence bucket.```upload link withheld```
Liam O'Connor: good. Create a secure evidence export and add an integrity checksum (sha256). Also we need to notify Compliance if audit gaps affect regulated customers.
Security Team: we'll take lead on evidence collection and chain-of-custody. Action: 1) collect kube audit logs from 11:50–12:30 2) export auth-proxy memory dump 3) lock down access to evidence bucket. Assigned to Security Team, ETA EOD.
Priya Singh: SRE action: add defensive rate-limiting on KMS calls and increase cache TTL. Also add prometheus alert for KMS latency > 200ms. Assigned to Ravi, due tomorrow 1700 UTC.
Maya Chen: Support follow-up: update affected customers with RCA note and ETA for follow-up postmortem. Priya, can you draft the customer-facing summary?
Priya Singh: will draft and post to #customer-comm at 15:00 UTC.
Liam O'Connor: Scheduling postmortem: proposing 2026-06-05 16:00 UTC (60m) — invite sent to SRE, Security, Support, Product, and Compliance. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/pm-1719901123 (private).
Maya Chen: action items recap (from thread):
- Security Team: collect audit logs 11:50–12:30, export evidence, lock bucket (owner: Security Team, due: EOD)
- Ravi Patel: implement KMS rate-limiting + cache changes, add prometheus alert (owner: Ravi, due: 2026-06-04 17:00 UTC)
- Priya Singh: draft customer-facing RCA and post to #customer-comm (owner: Priya, due: 2026-06-03 15:00 UTC)
- Liam O'Connor: assemble timeline and artifacts in s3://redwood-incidents/1719901123/ and lead postmortem (owner: Liam, due: pre-incident review)
- Support-Bot: create/update support tickets with RCA link (owner: Support, due: 2026-06-03 18:00 UTC)
Security Team: noted — we also discovered a gap in audit ingestion telemetry; I'll file a follow-up JIRA (SEC-883) to add end-to-end checks so ingestion failures surface as a P1 bell.
Priya Singh: small mitigation note: temporarily route KMS calls through a lower-latency path (direct in-region) for the affected customers until cache + rate-limits are fully rolled.
Maya Chen: QA request: @Security Team please confirm if any PII exposure is possible due to missing audit logs. If yes, escalate to Legal.
Security Team: initial assessment — no evidence of exfiltration found in node captures; missing entries are metadata/audit events, not payloads. Will confirm in final report.
Liam O'Connor: thanks team. I'll post the incident timeline and preliminary RCA in this thread before the postmortem. If anyone adds artifacts, tag me.
Maya Chen: closing the live incident: incident-bot status -> resolved. Postmortem invites and follow-ups scheduled. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: inference-gateway-prod. Incident ID: INC-20260603-1719901123. Duration: 00:25:45. Severity: Sev2.
Support-Bot: Customers notified. Tickets updated with incident ID INC-20260603-1719901123.
Liam O'Connor: thread note: discovered config rollback from 2026-06-02 23:15 introduced the low cache TTL; add config-change guardrails to change-control playbook (action item added).
Security Team: will post final evidence bundle and SHA256 checksums to the secure channel once upload completes.
Maya Chen: thanks all. Follow-ups will be tracked in the postmortem doc and SEC-883. I'll mark this thread for the postmortem and compliance handoff.
